title: Technical Product Manager learning roadmap
summary: TPM foundation, portfolio, and hiring prep

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Establish the technical baseline needed to converse fluently with engineers.

milestones.title: API and system basics
milestones.outcome: Can explain REST principles, authentication flows, and system components to engineers.

tasks.title: Read API fundamentals on MDN
tasks.description: Study the MDN guide on HTTP methods, status codes, and REST conventions.

tasks.title: Sketch a simple API diagram
tasks.description: Draw a diagram of request-response flow for a CRUD endpoint using pen and paper.

tasks.title: Watch a freeCodeCamp video on authentication
tasks.description: Focus on token-based auth (JWT) and how it fits into API design.

tasks.title: Write a one-page API glossary
tasks.description: Define key terms (endpoint, payload, rate limit, etc.) for future reference.

milestones.title: SQL fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Can query a relational database to retrieve, filter, and aggregate data for product decisions.

tasks.title: Complete SQL basics on Khan Academy
tasks.description: Finish the introductory lessons covering SELECT, WHERE, and ORDER BY.

tasks.title: Run sample queries in SQLiteStudio
tasks.description: Load the public Chinook database and practice retrieving top-selling tracks.

tasks.title: Write a summary of aggregation functions
tasks.description: Explain GROUP BY, COUNT, SUM, and AVG with example outputs.

tasks.title: Discuss query results with a developer friend
tasks.description: Explain what you learned and ask for feedback on query efficiency.

phases.title: Core skills
phases.summary: Develop the product-focused competencies that TPMs use daily.

milestones.title: Technical specs writing
milestones.outcome: Can produce clear, actionable technical specifications for engineering teams.

tasks.title: Read Atlassian guide on spec docs
tasks.description: Focus on structure, acceptance criteria, and diagrams.

tasks.title: Create a spec for a login API
tasks.description: Include endpoint, request/response schemas, error handling, and mock data.

tasks.title: Peer-review spec with a developer
tasks.description: Gather concrete feedback on clarity and completeness.

tasks.title: Iterate spec based on feedback
tasks.description: Update the document to address all reviewer comments.

milestones.title: Prioritisation frameworks
milestones.outcome: Can apply data-driven methods to rank features and technical debt.

tasks.title: Study RICE scoring on ProductPlan blog
tasks.description: Understand Reach, Impact, Confidence, and Effort components.

tasks.title: Score three hypothetical features using RICE
tasks.description: Calculate numeric scores and justify rankings.

tasks.title: Write a short rationale for top-ranked feature
tasks.description: Explain why it wins and how it aligns with business goals.

tasks.title: Share the scoring sheet with a product community
tasks.description: Post in a relevant forum and solicit critique.

milestones.title: Delivery planning
milestones.outcome: Can construct realistic release plans and track progress across squads.

tasks.title: Read Scrum guide section on sprint planning
tasks.description: Focus on backlog grooming, capacity planning, and definition of done.

tasks.title: Map a two-month roadmap for a mock platform
tasks.description: Identify milestones, dependencies, and release dates in a simple Gantt view.

tasks.title: Create a sprint backlog for the first month
tasks.description: Select user stories, estimate effort, and assign owners.

tasks.title: Reflect on risks and mitigation strategies
tasks.description: Write a brief risk register for the roadmap.

phases.title: Proof of work
phases.summary: Apply learned skills to tangible portfolio pieces that showcase TPM competence.

milestones.title: API Product specification
milestones.outcome: Portfolio includes a polished spec that demonstrates end-to-end thinking.

tasks.title: Select a public API to improve
tasks.description: Choose an existing open API (e.g., OpenWeather) and identify a missing feature.

tasks.title: Draft a full spec document
tasks.description: Include purpose, endpoint design, data model, error handling, and mock responses.

tasks.title: Add a visual flow diagram
tasks.description: Use draw.io to illustrate request-response sequences.

tasks.title: Publish the spec on GitHub Pages
tasks.description: Create a repo, push the doc, and enable a simple site for reviewers.

milestones.title: Technical roadmap for a platform
milestones.outcome: Shows ability to align technical initiatives with business objectives over time.

tasks.title: Define platform vision and goals
tasks.description: Write a one-page vision statement with measurable outcomes.

tasks.title: Identify three major epics and dependencies
tasks.description: Break down high-level work into epics, noting cross-team impacts.

tasks.title: Create a quarterly roadmap visual
tasks.description: Use a free tool like Google Slides to plot epics across quarters.

tasks.title: Write a brief executive summary
tasks.description: Explain why the roadmap supports the product strategy.

tasks.title: Share roadmap with a mentor for feedback
tasks.description: Ask a senior TPM to critique clarity and feasibility.

milestones.title: Data-backed feature proposal
milestones.outcome: Demonstrates analytical rigor and persuasive communication for feature decisions.

tasks.title: Choose a feature idea and gather data
tasks.description: Use public datasets on Kaggle or Google Trends to support need analysis.

tasks.title: Run SQL queries to extract key metrics
tasks.description: Calculate usage frequency, conversion impact, and revenue potential.

tasks.title: Write a proposal deck (5 slides)
tasks.description: Include problem, data insights, solution, impact, and implementation plan.

tasks.title: Record a 2-minute pitch video
tasks.description: Present the proposal as if to stakeholders and upload to YouTube (unlisted).

tasks.title: Gather feedback from a product community
tasks.description: Post the deck link and ask for critique on clarity and data use.

phases.title: Getting ready
phases.summary: Fine-tune advanced TPM capabilities and prepare for interviews or client engagements.

milestones.title: Developer empathy & collaboration
milestones.outcome: Can effectively bridge business and engineering perspectives in meetings.

tasks.title: Read "The Manager's path" chapter on empathy
tasks.description: Focus on techniques for active listening and technical translation.

tasks.title: Shadow a sprint demo meeting (recorded)
tasks.description: Observe how engineers discuss trade-offs and note language cues.

tasks.title: Write a debrief summarizing engineers' concerns
tasks.description: Translate technical jargon into business impact statements.

tasks.title: Pair-program with a junior engineer for 30 min
tasks.description: Collaborate on a small bug fix to experience their workflow.

milestones.title: Advanced delivery & risk management
milestones.outcome: Design effective release strategies and anticipate technical risks

tasks.title: Study post-mortem analysis guide on Atlassian
tasks.description: Learn structure for documenting failures and learnings.

tasks.title: Create a risk matrix for your platform roadmap
tasks.description: Rate likelihood and impact for each identified risk.

tasks.title: Draft a mitigation plan for top three risks
tasks.description: Specify actions, owners, and timelines to address each risk.

tasks.title: Present the risk plan to a peer group
tasks.description: Explain rationale and gather critique on completeness.

milestones.title: Interview & client readiness
milestones.outcome: Will confidently articulate experience and solve case studies in TPM interviews.

tasks.title: Read Cracking the PM interview chapter on case studies
tasks.description: Focus on structuring answers for product and technical scenarios.

tasks.title: Practice a mock prioritisation case (30 min timer)
tasks.description: Rank five feature ideas using RICE and write a concise justification.

tasks.title: Record yourself answering the case and review
tasks.description: Identify gaps in clarity, structure, and technical depth.

tasks.title: Schedule a mock interview with a senior TPM
tasks.description: Get live feedback on communication and problem-solving approach.
